AboutSection.description: For over a decade, Cargo Track Relocations has delivered premier relocation, freight, and logistics solutions across Saudi Arabia and worldwide. With major branches in Jeddah, Riyadh, and Dammam, we simplify international moves, corporate mobility, and storage through an end-to-end, stress-free approach.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To provide secure, tailored, and hassle-free relocation solutions backed by expert craftsmanship and global standards.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To be the regional leader in mobility, recognized for total reliability, safety, and worldwide logistics alliances.

AboutSection.strengthsTitle: Built for complete peace of mind

ServicesSection.introText: From seamless household moves and office relocations to specialized artwork handling, pet relocation, and deep cleaning, Cargotrack manages every detail with precision, care, and professionalism.

services.title: Household Goods Relocation
services.description: Our household relocation service includes packing and assembling furniture and other household items, transportation, unpacking and placing your household belongings.

services.title: Vehicle Relocation & Road Transportation
services.description: We provide professional, reliable, and flexible road transportation solutions tailored to your needs. We also offer seamless vehicle relocation services worldwide, ensuring safe, efficient, and cost-effective transportation.

services.title: Transportation
services.description: CargoTrack provides safe and reliable transportation services across Saudi Arabia and the GCC. We handle local transport, container shipping, FTL, LTL, and smooth customs clearance for import/export cargo.

services.title: Artwork Packing and Handling Service
services.description: We provide specialized artwork relocation with expert handling, secure packing, and safe transportation, ensuring your valuable pieces are protected and carefully managed from start to finish.

services.title: Pet Relocation
services.description: Our pet relocation services cover every aspect of your pet’s journey, including safe pick-up and delivery, preparation of required documentation, and provision of suitable travel crates and facilities for a smooth and comfortable relocation.

services.title: Storage Services
services.description: Cargotrack offers secure and convenient storage solutions to meet your short or long-term needs, giving you peace of mind that your belongings are safe and protected.

services.title: Industrial Packing
services.description: Our industrial packing services provide secure, reliable solutions for transporting heavy machinery and valuable equipment, using high-quality packing materials and specialized techniques to ensure maximum protection throughout the journey.

services.title: Office Relocation
services.description: Our professional office relocation services are designed to make business moves seamless and efficient. From detailed planning and secure packing to transportation, unpacking, and setup, we handle your office equipment, furniture, and belongings with care and precision.

services.title: Freight Forwarding
services.description: CargoTrack delivers complete air, sea, and land freight forwarding services across Saudi Arabia and globally. We manage everything from cargo booking and documentation to customs clearance and final delivery.

services.title: Pilgrim Baggage Handling
services.description: Pilgrim baggage handling services play a crucial role in ensuring a hassle-free and smooth pilgrimage experience for those visiting the holy cities of Mecca and Medina in Saudi Arabia.

services.title: Mobility Services
services.description: We offer comprehensive mobility services to simplify your relocation process, including immigration, settling-in and destination services.

services.title: Deep Cleaning Service
services.description: We provide deep cleaning for homes, offices and facilities using eco-friendly products and equipment for spotless & hygienic results.

CargoJourneySection.description: From specialized packing and customs coordination to international air/ocean freight and destination doorstep setup, CargoTrack streamlines your entire moving journey.

originCard.title: Origin
points: Pre-Move Survey – Assessing your shipment and planning the move.
Professional Packing – Safe and secure packing of your belongings.
Freight Services – Reliable transportation from origin to destination.
Move Coordination – Managing and coordinating every step of the shipment.

destinationCard.title: Destination
points: Customs Clearance – Handling the required customs procedures and documentation.
Transportation – Safe delivery of your shipment to the final destination.
Offloading – Careful unloading of your belongings at the delivery location.
Unpacking – Unpacking and placing your items as required.
Furniture Assembly & Fixing – Reassembling furniture and other items at your new location.

WhyChooseSection.description: We go beyond moving shipments—we simplify your entire supply chain and relocation journey with industry-leading care, global coverage, and unyielding precision.

features.title: Uncompromising Security
features.desc: Advanced tracking and secure packing protocols ensure your cargo and personal belongings are protected at every stage.

features.title: Global Reach, Local Expertise
features.desc: Extensive international network paired with deep regional customs knowledge for effortless cross-border moves.

features.title: Time-Definite Delivery
features.desc: Optimized route planning and priority freight handling to ensure precise, on-time arrivals every time.

features.title: End-to-End Visibility
features.desc: Real-time tracking, proactive status updates, and transparent logistics management from pickup to placement.

features.title: Dedicated Moving Experts
features.desc: Tailored customer support and personalized care from dedicated account managers available whenever you need them.

features.title: Cost & Value Efficiency
features.desc: Transparent pricing structures and strategic consolidation solutions that maximize convenience without hidden fees.
